english_translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Amr: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who gives bribes and the one who takes bribes.

narrators.name: ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ
narrators.full_name: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن المغيرة بن الحارث بن أبي ذئب القرشي العامري المدني

narrators.name: الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
narrators.full_name: الحارث بن عبد الرحمن بن أبي ذباب الأنصاري المدني

narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف الزهري المدني

narrators.name: عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو
narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص السهمي القرشي

chainIssues: Mix of explicit terms (حَدَّثَنَا, حَدَّثَنِي) and ambiguous term (عَنْ) present in chain
The use of عَنْ from Abu Salamah (Second Generation) is generally acceptable as he is not known as a mudallis

plainChains: Ibn Abi Dhi'b -> al-Harith ibn Abd al-Rahman -> Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman -> Abdullah ibn Amr -> Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

potential_issues.issue: Use of ambiguous transmission term 'an (عَنْ) from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman
potential_issues.impact: Minor concern as Abu Salamah is not classified as a mudallis and is highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt), one of the seven jurists of Medina

potential_issues.issue: Use of ambiguous transmission term 'an (عَنْ) from Abdullah ibn Amr
potential_issues.impact: No significant concern as he is a Companion, and all Companions are considered trustworthy ('udul)

IISGrade_reasoning: All narrators are highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt or Thiqah), with one being a Companion. The chain uses mostly explicit transmission terms (حَدَّثَنَا, حَدَّثَنِي) with some use of 'an (عَنْ) from reliable non-mudallis narrators. No disconnections, weak narrators, or significant reliability issues. The minor use of ambiguous terms from highly reliable narrators does not significantly impact the grade.
arabicText: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي خَالِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، قَالَ : لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الرَّاشِيَ وَالْمُرْتَشِيَ
